scripts/api/mqtt/variant_labels.py.
IT IS EMPTY, AND THAT IS THE POINT. Seeded 2026-09-09 with zero entries, immediately after
the 20 Tier-1 label corrections landed. The gate it serves runs at threshold 0 with no
baseline, so this file exists as a DOCUMENTED ESCAPE HATCH rather than as a list of things
already being escaped. Creating it empty is deliberate: the next author who needs to publish
a scenario the contract has not caught up with should find the mechanism and its rules
already here, instead of inventing one under time pressure.
TWO HARD RULES FOR AN ENTRY:
1. The key is '<path relative to api/mqtt/prose/>:<groupId>:<value>'. Exactly two colons.
Keyed on `value`, never on `label` -- example-naming N-19, and `value` is what
VariantSelect.tsx:288 actually selects on.
2. The reason MUST name either the upstream issue that retires it, or the scenario the
contract does not carry. 'Legacy' and 'known issue' are not reasons.
WHY THIS IS NOT AN ALLOWLIST. Every entry is printed in full on every run, before a single
finding, so waiving something costs a line of output on every push forever. And a waiver
that is no longer needed is itself a FAILURE: once the label starts matching, the recorded
reason has become a false statement about this repository, and the gate reports the entry as
STALE. There is no way to silence an individual finding permanently.
WHAT THIS FILE IS NOT FOR. It is not for a label you would prefer to word differently.
Example-naming T-1 permits CASE repair on an inherited name and forbids rewording it --
'Delete wifi ca cert' becomes 'Delete Wi-Fi CA cert', NOT 'Delete Wi-Fi CA certificate'.
The 27 editorial rewordings considered in .ai-history/077-select-variant-fix.md section 4
are forbidden, not deferred, so none of them may be waived into existence here.
